item.title: “I was on a bridge ready to jump”: How a gaming community helped save a veteran’s life
item.description: For many veterans, the toughest battles don’t end when the uniform comes off. For retired Army medic Anthony Potter, the fight followed him home.

item.title: One dead in quadruple shooting on Liberty Heights Avenue, four guns recovered
item.description: Baltimore Police confirm one death in quadruple shooting on Liberty Heights Avenue. Two wrecked cars and four guns recovered at scene, investigation ongoing.

item.title: 1 dead, 1 injured following Northeast Baltimore crash
item.description: One person is dead after a crash in Northeast Baltimore Monday night. A second person sustained serious but non-life-threatening injuries and was taken to a hospital.
